提供 React 组件与动画、数据处理、宿主环境工具和 HTTP 客户端。 使用: React components and animation, data utilities, host platform tools, and an HTTP client. Written in TypeScript with on-demand imports.
prune 按条件筛选树节点，同时保留匹配项的父级路径。返回新树，保留节点类型，: prune filters tree nodes while retaining the parent paths of matches. It returns a new tree, preserves node types, and leaves the original data unchanged.

占位的意义在于让用户提前看到页面结构。如果骨架和真实内容的尺寸对不上，数据到达时: Placeholders preview the structure of a page. If the skeleton and final content have different dimensions, the page jumps when data arrives, which can be more distracting than empty space. Text placeholders should inherit the real font size and line height, with a shorter final line to suggest the end of a paragraph.
